name: SEC Schedule 13D / 13G activist and 5% stakes to Google Sheets (Apify)

parameters.content:
## SEC Schedule 13D / 13G activist and 5% stakes to Google Sheets (Apify)

1. Add your **Apify** credential (Apify API token) to the Apify node.
2. Add a **Google Sheets** credential and pick your spreadsheet in the last node.
3. Edit the input JSON in the Apify node (put your own email in `secContactEmail`: the SEC requires every automated request to identify its sender).
4. Click Execute workflow. The Actor is pay per event: [https://apify.com/johnveds15/sec-13d-13g-ownership-stakes](https://apify.com/johnveds15/sec-13d-13g-ownership-stakes). The Apify node's *Maximum Cost per Run* is set so one run cannot exceed it.
